findings.body: Selecting a shortcut immediately changes this controlled select’s value from `brand:bankId` to the bare bank ID. The selected option therefore jumps from “Popular brand cards” to the later “Banks” group after an arrow-key change, so keyboard users cannot browse the shortcuts in order. The browser test uses `selectOption` and checks Tab order, which does not catch this. Keep the picker’s selected value separate from the bank ID sent on save, and test shortcut selection with keyboard input. [React’s controlled-select documentation](https://react.dev/reference/react-dom/components/select) describes this value-matching behavior.
